value_unit: Raw integer VALUE, in USD for the selected post-2023 filings; never multiply by 1000.
filing_universe: Match both COVERPAGE.REPORTCALENDARORQUARTER and SUBMISSION.PERIODOFREPORT to the stated report date; SUBMISSIONTYPE=13F-HR; ISAMENDMENT is not Y. Per CIK choose earliest FILING_DATE, then lexicographically smallest ACCESSION_NUMBER.
stock_title_classes: sponsored adrsponsored adsadrequitycmncl bord shscl a comclass a comcap stk cl acomm stkcl b newcap stk cl ccl a newforeign stockshs cl a
title_normalization: Lowercase only, exactly as the original helper; do not trim TITLEOFCLASS.
original_helper_limitation: Missing commas concatenate adjacent literals. Preserve the actually evaluated original allowlist for SkillsBench compatibility; this package is not a correction of the financial stock universe.
q1: Sum VALUE of all INFOTABLE rows in the chosen current filing. This is reported holdings value, not the manager's entire economic AUM.
q2: Count INFOTABLE rows in the chosen current filing whose normalized TITLEOFCLASS belongs to stock_title_classes. Count rows, not distinct CUSIPs. PUTCALL and SSHPRNAMTTYPE add no extra filter.
q3: In each chosen filing, filter by stock_title_classes, then sum VALUE by CUSIP. Current minus baseline, with missing CUSIP treated as zero. Keep positive increases and rank by increase descending; output the first five CUSIPs. New cases exclude ties within the top five or at its cutoff.
q4: For the supplied CUSIP, sum VALUE of all rows in each chosen current filing, without a title or PUTCALL filter. Rank by value descending. Output the first three original COVERPAGE.FILINGMANAGER_NAME values. New cases exclude ties within the top three or at its cutoff.
identifiers: CIK and CUSIP are strings; preserve leading zeros in CUSIP. CIK may be normalized to 10 digits with leading zeros.
numeric_answers: Original q1 rule: abs(answer / reference - 1) < 0.001 (strict 0.1% relative tolerance); q2 exact numeric equality. Reference calculations use integer VALUE without rounding.
name_comparison: Original q4 rule: lowercase both strings, with no whitespace trimming; list rank/order matters.
accuracy: Ten answer items per query case: q1, q2, five ordered q3 slots, three ordered q4 slots. Missing/invalid items are incorrect. Extra cases and extra ranked entries add error items. Runtime and format checks are reported separately from answer accuracy.
